title: Espresso Macchiato with a Spoon of Foam
summary: A double espresso in a demitasse, marked with a spoonful of stiff, sweet milk foam in the centre of the crema.

ingredients.note: only the foam is used, about 2 tbsp

steps.title: Make the foam
steps.text: Aerate the milk generously, keeping the wand tip high until it roughly doubles, then heat it to 60-65 °C. Tap the jug and leave it for 30 s so the foam rises and firms up.

steps.title: Pull the shot
steps.text: Meanwhile, pull a double espresso, 18 g in and about 40 ml out, into the warm demitasse.

steps.title: Mark the crema
steps.text: Spoon 1-2 tbsp of the stiff foam onto the centre of the espresso, leaving a ring of brown crema around it. Just a spot of milk is the whole idea.

tips: Make the foam stiff, so it sits on the crema rather than sinking.
A single shot works too, for a smaller, milder drink.
Use the leftover steamed milk for a second coffee.
storage: Serve immediately. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
